gotchas: Premium is bought inside the signed-in web vault: vault.bitwarden.com/#/settings/subscription/premium (a hash route, so the route below opens the vault and the last step names it).

The page's last visible Upgrade button opens a dialog with split Stripe iframes (titles contain 'card number', 'expiration date', 'CVC'), a billing country select and a plain postal-code input; fill the postal code in an earlier call than the card number.
Sign-in is email-first: the email box and Continue, then the master password (Enter submits). After the first sign-in an onboarding page about the browser extension shows instead of the vault.

2026-10-09 (staging proxy, local egress): number, expiry (MM/YY) and CVC filled with the public test card under a verification-only key (card_fields_verified). Stopped before the purchase button; nothing was submitted.

route.note: Open #/settings/subscription/premium in the signed-in vault, then click the last visible Upgrade button.
